holds.reason: The exact Ferrara parallel does not establish the edition or work title meant by Heilprin. The parallel is documented for comparison.

notes.text: The Ferrara tale's critical transcription confirms the opening narrative and name. A separately transcribed parallel confirms the sequence, bread offered as charity, three impersonations and concluding oath. Several words differ. The available evidence does not determine which specific edition Heilprin meant by his abbreviated title.
